entities.summary: Christopher Howard Page is an English musicologist and performer who specializes in medieval music and early English guitar history. He is currently a Fellow of Sidney Sussex College, Cambridge and Emeritus Professor of Medieval Music and Literature in the Faculty of English, University of Cambridge.
